title: IBM SA21-9247 — 5250 Information Display System Functions Reference Manual
summary: Primary historical programming reference for the 5250 workstation data stream: device programming, commands, orders, fields, attributes, keyboard/AID behaviour and examples. RFC 1205 explicitly points implementers here and section 5 records corrections/enhancements relative to edition -6.
navigation_doctrine: Do not assume printed page 2-N equals PDF physical page N; front matter shifts physical pages.
Use `gopher reference find <pdf> <phrase>` for command/order names.
Use `gopher reference locate <pdf> --reference-page N --approx-page M --window K` when an RFC gives an approximate printed page.
Use `reference move` for continuation and surrounding tables.
correction_rule: After reading SA21-9247-6 for a behaviour, inspect RFC 1205 section 5 for a documented correction or enhancement before encoding the behaviour.
